name: Santana Minerals Limited
summary: Santana Minerals Limited engages in the exploration and evaluation of mineral properties in New Zealand and Cambodia. The company explores for gold deposits. It holds a 100% interest in the Bendigo-Ophir gold project that covers approximately an area of 324 square kilometers located in the Central Otago region of the South Island. Santana Minerals Limited was formerly known as Cerro Resources NL, Non-Cerro del Gallo Projects and Interests. The company was incorporated in 2013 and is based in Brisbane, Australia.
